{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rate in treatment arm
treatment_response_rate = data_dedup[data_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()

# Compute response rate in control arm
control_response_rate = data_dedup[data_dedup['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Compute difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

# Print results
treatment_response_rate, control_response_rate, treatment_effect"}
